propertySets.name: Pset_BalanceWeightTensionerDesignCriteria
propertySets.definition: Properties of a weight tensioner. The property set can be used by the predefined type TENSIONINGEQUIPMENT of IfcDiscreteAccessory.

properties.name: ReferenceDistanceRopeToPulley
properties.definition: The reference design criteria for distance from the end of the rope to the fixed pulley.It defines the nominal distance in relation to temperature.

properties.name: ReferenceDistanceTensionerToGround
properties.definition: The reference design criteria distance from the last tensioner to the ground or the base surface (B value). It defines the nominal distance in relation to temperature.

propertySets.name: Pset_DiscreteAccessoryTypeTensioningEquipment
propertySets.definition: Properties of tensioning equipment used in railway. The property set can be used by the predefined type TENSIONINGEQUIPMENT of IfcDiscreteAccessory.

properties.name: AssemblyInstruction
properties.definition: Instructions to describe how the system / equipment / facility is assembled.

properties.name: HasBreakLineLock
properties.definition: Indicates whether the equipment has the function of brake line lock or not.

properties.name: TensileStrength
properties.definition: Indicates the ability to withstand breakage apart under applied force.

properties.name: RatioOfWireTension
properties.definition: The ratio of wire tension to tensioner weight.

properties.name: TransmissionEfficiency
properties.definition: Transmission efficiency of the tensioning equipment.

propertySets.name: Pset_SpringTensioner
propertySets.definition: Properties of spring tensioner used in railway. The property set can be used by the predefined type TENSIONINGEQUIPMENT of IfcDiscreteAccessory.

properties.name: TensileStrength
properties.definition: Indicates the ability to withstand breakage apart under applied force.

properties.name: TensioningWorkingRange
properties.definition: The working range of the tensioning equipment under normal operation.
